name: Train Station Ticket Counter
place: A busy train station ticket counter
role: You are a station ticketing officer.
speaker: Ticket Officer

tasks.goal: Greet the ticket officer and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the ticket officer and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Ask for a one-way ticket to the capital city
tasks.hint: State your destination and requested ticket type.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a one-way train ticket to the capital.

tasks.goal: Inquire about high-speed express departure times
tasks.hint: Ask when the next fast express train departs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about express train departure times.

tasks.goal: Request a window seat in a quiet carriage
tasks.hint: Specify your seating preference for the journey.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a window seat in a quiet carriage.
tasks.scene_hint: Departure boards chime as passengers hurry past with rolling luggage.

tasks.goal: Ask about luggage allowance and storage overhead
tasks.hint: Inquire how many bags you can bring on board without extra fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about luggage allowances and storage rules.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'platform'
tasks.hint: Platform is where trains dock. Ask which platform your train departs from.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'platform'.

tasks.goal: Ask if student or senior fare discounts apply
tasks.hint: Inquire whether special reduced rates are available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about student or senior ticket discounts.

tasks.goal: Request a transfer to an earlier departure train
tasks.hint: Politely ask to change your booking after a schedule change.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a transfer to an earlier train.

tasks.goal: Inquire about bicycle reservation rules on trains
tasks.hint: Ask if bikes require a dedicated ticket or spot.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about rules for bringing a bicycle on board.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification on connection times between trains
tasks.hint: Inquire if 10 minutes is enough time to switch platforms.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about connection time safety between trains.
tasks.scene_hint: Intercom announcements echo faintly across the tiled station concourse.

tasks.goal: Inquire if meals or refreshments are sold on board
tasks.hint: Ask if there is a dining car or food cart on the train.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about food service on board the train.

tasks.goal: Confirm ticket refund and cancellation conditions
tasks.hint: Ask what happens if your travel plans change.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ticket refund or cancellation rules.

tasks.goal: Request a printed timetable and seat assignment receipt
tasks.hint: Ask for paper confirmation of your itinerary.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a printed timetable or seat confirmation.

tasks.goal: Verify platform track number before heading to gate
tasks.hint: Ask the officer to double-check the departure track number.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified the departure platform track number.

tasks.goal: Thank the ticket officer and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the ticket officer AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Ask if the express train features power outlets and onboard Wi-Fi
tasks.hint: Inquire about electrical sockets and internet connectivity on the train.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard power outlets and Wi-Fi.

tasks.goal: Specify first-class or standard quiet carriage seating preference
tasks.hint: State your seating preference when buying tickets.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified first-class or quiet coach seating preference.

tasks.goal: Ask if train offers bicycle rack storage reservations
tasks.hint: Inquire if full-size bicycles are permitted in luggage cars.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bicycle storage reservation rules.

tasks.goal: Verify destination platform number on electronic departure board
tasks.hint: Ask clerk which track or platform your train departs from.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified departure platform number at ticket counter.

tasks.goal: Inquire about connecting shuttle bus schedules at arrival station
tasks.hint: Ask if local bus transfers coordinate with train arrivals.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about connecting shuttle bus schedules.

tasks.goal: Confirm refund policy if train trip is delayed over one hour
tasks.hint: Ask what compensation is provided for major rail delays.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified delay compensation and refund terms.

tasks.goal: Request a printed receipt for business travel expense claim
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for itemized expense receipt with VAT details.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested itemized train ticket receipt.

tasks.goal: Verify lost property office location inside main concourse
tasks.hint: Ask where to report lost items left on passenger coaches.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified location of station lost property office.

tasks.goal: Confirm station overnight locker storage availability and pricing
tasks.hint: Ask where passenger luggage can be stored for several hours.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about station luggage locker facilities.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'timetable'
tasks.hint: A timetable is a schedule showing times when public transport arrives and departs. Ask for a printed train timetable.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'timetable'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'concession'
tasks.hint: Concession refers to discounted fares. Ask if senior concession rates apply.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'concession'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'cancellation'
tasks.hint: Cancellation refers to stopping a service. Ask about ticket cancellation policies.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'cancellation'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'locomotive'
tasks.hint: Locomotive refers to the train engine. Ask if historic steam locomotives operate on this route.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'locomotive'.

tasks.goal: Ask if sleeper car private berths are available on overnight express
tasks.hint: Inquire about sleeping coach options for overnight travel.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about private sleeper compartment availability.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether dining car serves vegetarian hot meal options
tasks.hint: Ask about food options available on long-distance trains.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about dietary options in the train dining car.

tasks.goal: Report ticket printing machine error code at self-service kiosk
tasks.hint: Inform ticket counter staff that digital kiosk malfunctioned.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported self-service kiosk ticket printing error.

tasks.goal: Request seat near power outlets and window for laptop work
tasks.hint: Specify seat amenities needed during travel.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested seat near power socket and window.
tasks.scene_hint: Solari split-flap departure boards clack loudly as train times update above concourse.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification regarding peak hour ticket price surcharges
tasks.hint: Inquire why morning travel costs more than afternoon trains.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about peak hour ticket pricing surcharges.

tasks.goal: Inquire about accessibility ramps for wheelchair boarding
tasks.hint: Ask how passenger with mobility aid boards train coach.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about wheelchair accessibility boarding assistance.

tasks.goal: Report lost physical ticket before boarding scheduled train
tasks.hint: Inform clerk that printed ticket was lost in concourse.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported lost train ticket prior to departure.
tasks.scene_hint: Echoing echoes of echoey station announcements reverberate under vaulted glass arches.

tasks.goal: Ask if pet carriers are permitted in passenger compartments
tasks.hint: Inquire about rules for small pets traveling in carriers.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pet carrier policies on passenger trains.

tasks.goal: Request rebooking onto later train due to flight arrival delay
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to transfer ticket to evening departure.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested ticket rebooking for later departure time.

tasks.goal: Inquire about group discount rates for ten traveling passengers
tasks.hint: Ask if group bookings receive discounted fare rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about group booking discount thresholds.

tasks.goal: Ask for instructions on scanning QR code at automatic turnstile gates
tasks.hint: Ask clerk how to tap digital ticket ticket gates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to scan ticket at automatic gate turnstiles.
tasks.scene_hint: Steam hisses from brake lines as electric locomotive glides alongside platform numbers.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy regarding heavy oversized luggage fees
tasks.hint: Ask weight and dimension limits for free checked baggage.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about excess luggage size and weight limits.

tasks.goal: Inquire if train service is affected by track maintenance work
tasks.hint: Ask if bus substitution operates on weekend routes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about track maintenance service disruptions.

tasks.goal: Ask if Wi-Fi internet connection is free in second class coaches
tasks.hint: Inquire about onboard internet access availability.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard Wi-Fi internet access terms.

tasks.goal: Request assistance printing boarding pass from digital booking reference
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to print ticket using 6-character booking code.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested ticket printing using booking reference.
tasks.scene_hint: Smell of roasted coffee beans and diesel exhaust lingers near ticket queue barriers.

tasks.goal: Inquire about multi-country rail pass validation rules
tasks.hint: Ask if regional rail pass must be stamped before first journey.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about rail pass validation requirements.

tasks.goal: Report misprinted date on physical paper ticket
tasks.hint: Point out error in travel date printed by ticket machine.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported misprinted date on train ticket.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether ticket gate accepts contactless mobile payments
tasks.hint: Ask if fare gates accept smartphone digital wallet taps.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked contactless payment options at fare gates.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished marble floors reflect glowing amber LED arrival screens near ticket windows.

tasks.goal: Ask if children under age five travel free without assigned seat
tasks.hint: Inquire about child fare exemption rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about free travel age limits for children.

tasks.goal: Request seat change away from train restroom area
tasks.hint: Politely ask clerk to reassign seat location.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested seat reassignment away from restrooms.

tasks.goal: Inquire about scenic tourist train routes through mountain passes
tasks.hint: Ask for recommendations on panoramic railway journeys.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about scenic mountain railway routes.

tasks.goal: Ask if regional train ticket allows unlimited stopovers along route
tasks.hint: Negotiate flexible route stopovers before reaching destination.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about intermediate stopover privileges on ticket.

tasks.goal: Report broken seat recline mechanism in reserved carriage
tasks.hint: Inform conductor or counter staff of seat defect.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported malfunctioning seat recline control.
tasks.scene_hint: Whistle blasts sharply as station master waves green signal flag along track 4.

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendation on fastest transit route to international airport
tasks.hint: Inquire whether express train or subway is faster.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for fastest rail route to airport terminal.

tasks.goal: Request station map showing elevator locations for heavy suitcases
tasks.hint: Ask clerk where concourse elevators are situated.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested station layout map showing elevators.
tasks.scene_hint: Newspaper kiosks and pastry stands line bustling passenger walkways near ticket booths.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether overnight train ticket includes complimentary breakfast
tasks.hint: Ask if morning meal is provided in sleeper class.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about meal inclusion in sleeper ticket.

tasks.goal: Ask if senior citizen discount requires presenting passport
tasks.hint: Inquire what photo identification proves age eligibility.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ID requirements for senior discount.

tasks.goal: Inquire about policy on drinking personal alcohol on long-distance trains
tasks.hint: Ask if personal food and beverages are permitted onboard.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about rules for personal food and drink consumption.

tasks.goal: Report malfunctioning air conditioning in assigned coach
tasks.hint: Inform clerk of uncomfortably hot carriage temperatures.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported carriage air conditioning failure.
tasks.scene_hint: Automated ticket machines chime softly as credit card readers process payments.

tasks.goal: Ask if train schedule changes during heavy snowfall conditions
tasks.hint: Check winter weather disruption contingency plans.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about train operations during winter weather.

tasks.goal: Inquire about quiet zone carriage rules regarding mobile phone calls
tasks.hint: Ask if phone conversations are prohibited in designated coaches.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about noise rules in quiet carriages.

tasks.goal: Request assistance finding platform elevator with heavy stroller
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for step-free route to departure platform.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested step-free route guidance to train platform.
tasks.scene_hint: Brass clock hands tick toward departure time above central concourse entrance.

tasks.goal: Ask about policy on exchange rates when paying with foreign currency
tasks.hint: Inquire if station ticket counter accepts foreign banknotes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about foreign currency payment policies.

tasks.goal: Clarify procedure if train breaks down midway through journey
tasks.hint: Ask how passenger replacement transport is organized.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about emergency procedures during train breakdowns.

tasks.goal: Inquire about student semester pass application process
tasks.hint: Ask what proof of university enrollment is needed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about applying for student semester travel passes.

tasks.goal: Report uncleaned trash left in seating compartment
tasks.hint: Inform station staff of untidy condition inside coach.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported untidy seat compartment condition.
tasks.scene_hint: Squeal of steel wheels braking echoes down long subterranean train tunnels.

tasks.goal: Ask if seat reservation can be purchased separately from ticket
tasks.hint: Inquire about seat assignment fee without main fare.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about standalone seat reservation fees.

tasks.goal: Request confirmation of total travel duration including layovers
tasks.hint: Ask clerk how long entire journey takes with transfer times.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about total travel duration including connections.

tasks.goal: Inquire about express luggage forwarding service to hotel
tasks.hint: Ask if station offers door-to-door baggage transport.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about luggage forwarding service to hotel.
tasks.scene_hint: Rows of yellow taxi cabs line up outside station main exit doors.

tasks.goal: Ask if ticket validity lasts for 24 hours from time of validation
tasks.hint: Inquire how long single ticket remains valid.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ticket validity duration.

tasks.goal: Request assistance reading timetable chart on wall display
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to clarify legend symbols on printed schedule.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help interpreting timetable display chart.

name_translations.Japanese: 鉄道駅チケットカウンター

place_translations.Japanese: 繁忙的火车站售票窗口
